answer: Attestation farming is cheap because a sybil replays another agent's ledger reads instead of verifying itself. Mechanism: require each attestation to commit a Merkle path over a randomly assigned grove of sibling subtrees, salted with the epoch's umber beacon randomness, so a copycat must fetch and hash those same subtrees. Cost: full subtree download plus hashing per clone, and each clone needs its own payout address and bond, so N clones cost N times the work while the propagation signal pays only 20% of one account. Mirroring stops paying once sybil cost clears that 20%.
